fact.m1: In 1926 Robert Goddard launched the first liquid-fuel rocket — it climbed only 12.5 metres!
fact.m2: Space officially begins at the Kármán line — 100 km. In our scaled game the atmosphere ends at 70 km (1:10 scale).
fact.moon: Apollo astronauts brought 382 kg of Moon rock home! The Artemis missions will hunt for ice at the Moon's south pole.
hint.m1: Thrust must beat weight — watch the TWR in the builder!
hint.m1b: Want 3 stars? A parachute helps you land softly.
hint.m2: The engine burns fuel fighting the air — throttle down (S) low down, or tilt once you're high.
hint.explore.1: Look for glowing rings — samples hide there!
hint.explore.2: The radio scout looks toward the nearest sample!
hint.explore.3: Walk up to a sample and press {act} — time to drill!
fact.purple_crystal: Crystals grow where lava cooled long ago.
fact.iron_ore: Lunar soil is rich in iron — we could build parts right on the Moon!
fact.ice_cube_bug: Moon ice hides in crater shadows — it can become water and fuel.
fact.magma_rock: This rock was born inside a volcano long ago.
fact.gold_nugget: Gold arrives on planets inside asteroids!

lab.title: Sample collection
mission.mars.title: Mars Expedition
mission.mars.brief: Explore Mars: drill hematite, an ancient mudstone and buried ice, then call home!
flight.tip_start: Press Space (or “Engine ON”) to light the engine!
flight.tip_stage: This stage is empty — press Q (or “Stage”) to drop it!
flight.tip_cutoff: You're in space! Switch the engine off now — Space.
flight.tip_tilt: Tilt a little with D to fly further on the same fuel.
flight.tip_chute: Falling fast — open the parachute with C!
flight.tip_no_control: No flight computer on board — the rocket can't steer.
hint.m2b: Build two stages with a separator, and press Q when the first one runs dry.
hint.moon.ice: Ice hides in the dark of the craters. Artemis astronauts will look for it too!
hint.mars.mudstone: Mudstone formed at the bottom of an old lake — it might keep traces of ancient life!
hint.mars.dust: Martian dust is red because it is full of rust — iron oxide!
fact.mars: NASA's Perseverance rover is filling sample tubes in Jezero Crater, an old lake bed, for a future trip back to Earth.
explore.return: All set! Go back to the lander and beam the data home.
explore.arrive.moon: Welcome to the Moon! Gold rings mark the samples our tasks need.
explore.arrive.mars: Welcome to Mars! Gold rings mark the samples our tasks need. Mind the dust!
fact.mars_hematite: The Opportunity rover found tiny iron balls like these. They formed in water long ago!
fact.mars_mudstone: Mudstone is hardened lake mud. Perseverance drills rocks like it to look for signs of ancient life.
fact.mars_ice: In 2008 the Phoenix lander scraped the soil and found water ice just under the surface.
fact.mars_basalt: Basalt is cooled lava. Mars has Olympus Mons, the biggest volcano in the Solar System!
fact.mars_salt: Salt is left behind when water dries up — a clue that Mars once had lakes and seas.
